name: Bollinger band breakout (20, 2)
description: TREND FOLLOWING. A close outside the band read as the start of a move rather than as an excess - the reading Bollinger defends in Bollinger on Bollinger Bands (2001) against the more common fade of the same event. Canonical parameters: 20 periods, 2 standard deviations. BORN ON THE DAILY, on equity charts. It is the deliberate opposite of bollinger-mean-reversion, and the two are in this library together because on the same data at most one of them can be right: finding that both lose is the informative outcome.
